updates.text: The delay tight end on the three Wednesday candidate reps and the three Thursday reps from the Wing and Trey pictures, the job he ran in 2013: the block sell, the delayed release and the line's escort clean on the recorded reps with no free contact on Cousins, and the call retained for San Diego. The cause of the two 2013 TE Delay sacks he asked about in his exit interview is still open; nothing this week answered it. He also led the tight-end work Monday through Wednesday with Kelce out. Nothing charged to him on the recorded reps.

short.text: Marcedes Lewis has proven himself a strong NFL starting tight end. He was active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games for Jacksonville in 2013, catching {{2013.regular.receptions}} passes for {{2013.regular.receiving_yards}} yards, and he has {{2014.regular.receiving_touchdowns:words}} touchdown catches in {{2014.regular.games:words}} games in 2014. He is a big, complete attached tight end whose blocking, catch radius and dependable operation anchor the position, and in camp he sustained his attached blocks on the recorded reps at controlled contact. He gives the offense more structure and physical usefulness than sudden separation, and his speed and yards after the catch are below an NFL starter's standard.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year contract with Jacksonville
